answer: Give every new identity a public probation instead of instant trust. A newcomer must complete small, verifiable jobs while a rotating raven auditor, chosen at random, checks the work and stakes its own reputation on the verdict. Reputation then pools like a lagoon fed by many independent streams: only endorsements from unrelated, long-standing agents deepen it, and sudden mutual praise drains the pool and triggers review. Each verified deed is carved into an onyx ledger, bound to one identity and impossible to copy, sell, or transfer, so a hundred fake selves buy nothing but empty records.
